title: Tell the I-chart story honestly
brief: The {{exec}} asks whether a single unusually long discharge time proves that the entire process has deteriorated. Use the I-chart to answer and defend the recommendation.

exhibit.title: Weekly median discharge time in hours

options.label: Investigate W6 as a possible special cause without claiming the whole process shifted.
Announce that the process average has permanently worsened.
Ignore W6 because one point can never matter.

reasons.label: A point beyond the limits merits investigation, while the surrounding series does not show a sustained shift.
The target line is the same as a control limit.
Only monthly data can show special causes.

debrief.correct: Correct. Investigate the exceptional week, describe it as a possible special cause, and avoid overstating a permanent system change.
debrief.wrong: One exceptional point can deserve investigation without supporting a claim that the whole process permanently shifted.
debrief.rule_cited: Control-chart interpretation — distinguish an isolated special cause from a sustained change.
